implementation.registers_ports_variables: Explicit banks and typed JSON persistence, attached foreign globals and explicit system roots; no hardware acquisition
implementation.files: MemoryFiles or explicit DirectoryFiles root, atomic buffered close/interactive flush, attributes and synchronous file management
implementation.collections: Typed one-based PATH nodes/header and independent copies; initialized fixed-capacity FIFO queues tied to one backing array
implementation.control: Deterministic cooperative scheduler with virtual time, events, edges, EVAL, scan intervals and optional local lifetimes; typed supplied-source project linkage
implementation.geometry: Explicit standard-DH FK/numerical IK/reachability, limits/groups/frames/tools and external kinematic joints; extended per-axis comparison tolerances

portable_choices.status_codes: Register/path/variable/queue status conventions documented in offline-services.md; they do not assert a native alarm mapping
portable_choices.binary: Little endian by default, ATR_REVERSE big endian; ATR_UF unformatted, ATR_IA interactive flush; identifiers are package constants
portable_choices.stop: Terminal offline task stop; native KAREL STOP/RESUME motion behavior is outside this implementation
portable_choices.extended_axes: Zero-fill on widening, drop on narrowing; preserve on inverse/MIRROR, rightmost extended operand on colon, origin metadata on FRAME
portable_choices.mirror_orientation: Reflect about frame XZ, then reverse local Y to retain a proper rotation
portable_choices.queue: Capacity equals backing-array length, monotonically increasing sequence IDs, zero-filled unused backing slots
portable_choices.events: Broadcast generations consumed independently per handler/expression; coalesce multiple signals and retain context generations
portable_choices.scheduler: Round-robin checkpoints, default 1 ms virtual quantum, parked DELAY and explicit source entry; no host processes
portable_choices.persistence: Typed value snapshots include partial leaves and file bytes, but omit live resources and continuation state
portable_choices.inverse: Bounded damped numerical IK; failure does not prove geometric impossibility; config_ref=0 only
portable_choices.extended_comparison: Explicit scalar or three-axis absolute tolerances; missing plain-pose external values equal zero
